🔥 Description

Are you ready to earn while sharing comfort and wellness? Heatronics invites you to join our Affiliate Program and be part of a growing brand that’s transforming pain relief and winter comfort solutions.

🌟 Why Heatronics?

  • Trusted by thousands for innovative heat therapy products like heating pads, bed warmers, and ergonomic backrests.
  • Perfect for influencers in the health & wellness niche looking to make a positive impact.
  • Advanced technology, high-quality products, and a rapidly growing customer base!

💼 What’s in it for you?

  • 10% commission on every sale through your unique affiliate link.
  • Transfers made to your account every ₹10,000 you earn—hassle-free payments.
  • Promote products your audience will love—designed to solve real problems like pain relief, relaxation, and winter comfort.

🚀 How to Get Started?

  • Share your unique link across Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, or offline channels.
  • Track your performance and watch commissions roll in as your audience embraces Heatronics products.
  • Enjoy dedicated support and promotional tools to help you succeed.

🎉 Join Heatronics today and start earning while spreading warmth, comfort, and wellness! ❤️ Together, we inspire better living!
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Heatronics! Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, you agree to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Affiliate links are automatically generated, but you can also generate a specific affiliate link for a product or collection. If a person clicks on another affiliate’s referral link and later clicks on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliates may or may not be assigned a coupon code, with details and usage clarified in the Dashboard. If a customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses a coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you are not assigned a branded coupon, you are not allowed to promote coupons.

Affiliates may advertise the Heatronics website through online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, or offline channels like classified ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and Payment

When you refer a customer who makes a purchase on our website, you will earn a commission calculated based on the Commission Structure. Commission amounts are based on order value and do not include extra fees such as taxes or shipping costs.

To receive a commission, you must provide valid payment details in the Settings section. Payment schedules will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments are only made for successfully completed transactions. Heatronics reserves the right to review each referral order under a fair use policy. The status of commissions is displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commissions will be listed in the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be eligible for commission payouts.

4. Marketing Tools

We may share promotional materials such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing Tool tab. These can be downloaded or shared using an HTML embed code to promote Heatronics products on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, you can invite others to become your downline affiliates. If a downline affiliate generates sales, the upline affiliate will also earn a network commission, as per the merchant’s settings.

To invite others to the affiliate system, share your unique network link. Affiliates who click on the link and register will become part of your network.

6. Cookie Tracking

We use cookies to track users who click on your affiliate link. If a user does not allow cookies or clears their cookies, we cannot track their activity and will not be able to pay commissions for those referrals.

The cookie duration is specified on the Affiliate Registration Form. During the cookie period, every order made by the referred customer on the Heatronics website will automatically result in a commission for the affiliate, even if the customer does not click on the affiliate link again.

7. Removal from the Affiliate Program

If you wish to be removed from the Affiliate Program, please contact us at contact@heatronics.in.

Go Forward and Refer!

We’re thrilled to have you as part of the Heatronics Affiliate Program. If you have any questions or need support, feel free to reach out to us at contact@heatronics.in.

Thank you for partnering with Heatronics Medical Devices Pvt. Ltd., and we wish you success in all your referrals!
